The '''Iron Ring''' were a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] group that operated during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], primarily on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that had formerly been part of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. They had a presence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] and in about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] they entered an arrangement with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] wherby Darga would supply them with slaves that he had acquired as a result of a deal that he had made with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, the slaves that Darga supplied were of poor quality and many of them [[Death/Legends|died]] before the Iron Ring could sell them, so an Iron Ring delegation traveled to [[Darga the Hutt's palace|Darga's palace]] on Cato Neimoidia, to complain. A short [[Time/Legends|time]] later, Darga's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] [[Igren Demos]] persuaded two Iron Rings to assist in an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt against some undercover [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents that were staying in the [[palace]].
